    private static int itemMass;
    private static final boolean[] used = new boolean[100];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
            used[i] = false;

    }

        long right = 0;

                right += next;

                long next = findWeight(diff);
                if (next == 0) break;
                left += next;
            } else {

            }
        }
        return false;
    }

        int exponent = (int) (Math.log(target) / Math.log(weight));

        weight = scanner.nextInt();
